verdict.rationale: The axis applies because Oneleet ships its own AI agents (Fieldwork), so a buyer could fairly ask whether those agents can consume external MCP servers. The evidence, however, only documents the opposite role: an official Oneleet MCP server that outside assistants connect to via OAuth or service keys. That server-side evidence does not transfer to this client-side story, and nothing shows Oneleet plugging in third-party MCP servers.
